primary.$description: Brand primary. Indigo 600. The single action accent; every interactive affordance uses it.

primary-text-dark.$description: Primary outline, ghost and link text on dark surfaces. Indigo 600 is 2.83:1 on slate 900; indigo 400 is 5.98:1.

primary-text-strong-dark.$description: Primary soft label and pressed text on dark surfaces.

primary-outline-dark.$description: Primary outline border on dark surfaces.

primary-surface-dark.$description: Primary soft fill on dark surfaces.

primary-surface-hover-dark.$description: Primary soft fill on hover, dark surfaces.

primary-surface-press-dark.$description: Primary soft fill pressed, dark surfaces.

secondary.$description: Violet. Decorative accent only, never for interactive or action affordances.

success.$description: The success hue: the solid fill colour (jade).

success-strong.$description: AA-safe fill for a white glyph (at least 3:1 non-text).

success-solid-hover.$description: Solid fill on hover and the gradient end at rest.

success-solid-press.$description: Solid fill pressed, the solid border and the gradient end on hover.

success-on-solid.$description: Label on the solid fill; holds 4.5:1 on the 12% sheen, hover and press.

success-surface.$description: Soft fill, alert and badge background.

success-text.$description: Text and icons on light surfaces (4.5:1 on white and on the soft fills).

success-text-strong.$description: Alert titles, link hover and press.

success-outline.$description: Outline variant border (3:1 on light surfaces).

success-text-dark.$description: Text and icons on dark surfaces (4.5:1 on slate 900 / 950 and the dark soft fills).

success-text-strong-dark.$description: Alert titles, link hover and press on dark surfaces.

success-outline-dark.$description: Outline variant border on dark surfaces (3:1).

success-surface-hover-dark.$description: Soft fill on hover, dark surfaces.

success-border-dark.$description: Alert and badge hairline on dark surfaces.

neutral-solid.$description: Neutral solid fill (indigo-tinted ink). Label: neutral-on-solid.

neutral-solid-hover.$description: Neutral solid on hover (lighter, like slate 800 before).

neutral-solid-press.$description: Neutral solid pressed, solid border and gradient end.

neutral-text.$description: Neutral control label on light surfaces.

neutral-outline.$description: Neutral outline border (3:1 on light surfaces).

neutral-solid-dark.$description: Neutral solid on dark surfaces: inverts to a light fill so it stays visible.

neutral-solid-press-dark.$description: Neutral dark solid pressed and its border.

neutral-surface-press-dark.$description: Neutral soft fill pressed, dark surfaces.

text-body.$description: Reading body copy. Slate 700 for comfortable long-form contrast; muted stays at slate 500 (the AA floor).

focus-dark.$description: Focus ring on dark surfaces (indigo 600 is below 3:1 on slate 900).

control-border-dark.$description: Unchecked checkbox box and off switch track on dark surfaces (3.75:1 on slate 900, 4.24:1 on slate 950).

control-fill-dark.$description: Checked checkbox box and on switch track on dark surfaces. Indigo 600 is 2.83:1 on slate 900; indigo 400 is 5.98:1.

control-glyph-dark.$description: Check, dash and switch knob drawn on control-fill-dark or control-border-dark (5.98:1 on indigo 400, 3.75:1 on slate 500).

control-field-dark.$description: The inside of an unchecked checkbox box on dark surfaces.

control-disabled-dark.$description: Disabled checkbox box and switch track on dark surfaces. Inactive component, exempt from 1.4.11.

surface-dark.$description: Dark page and card surface. Every *-dark pair is checked against it.

text-muted-dark.$description: Muted text on dark surfaces: the dark floor (slate 500 is 3.75:1 on slate 900).

text-disabled-dark.$description: Disabled text on dark surfaces (exempt from 1.4.3).
